author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Boston-based New Balance has signed actor and writer Ayo Edebiri as a brand ambassador, adding a Boston-raised creative figure to its expanding group of partners in sports and entertainment.

Edebiri is best known for her award-winning performance as Sydney Adamu in “The Bear.” Her screen work also includes “Bottoms” and voice roles in animated productions, while her career has included writing and comedy. The partnership connects that broad cultural profile with a company whose identity remains closely tied to Greater Boston.

New Balance has widened its ambassador strategy in recent years, including the signing of baseball star Shohei Ohtani in 2023. Adding Edebiri gives the brand a partner with local roots and an audience that reaches well beyond athletics.

The announcement reported by the Boston Business Journal did not detail the financial terms or provide a full schedule of campaigns tied to the agreement. Future advertising and product appearances will show how the company uses the partnership. For now, the signing stands out as a hometown connection between one of Boston’s largest consumer brands and a prominent performer raised in the city.
dek: The Boston-based athletic brand added the award-winning actor and writer to a roster that spans sports and entertainment.
headline: New Balance signs Boston-raised actor Ayo Edebiri as ambassador
sourceName: Boston Business Journal via NBC10 Boston
